digest.component_or_area: bug-trend prevention program / observability and gate enforcement
propositions: Bug provenance must be observable at creation time and queryable via bug_trends metrics without requiring new user input.

Deterministic pre-LLM gates must prevent: raw git writes bypassing the store, unread config schema fields, unchecked wall-clock assertions in tests, incomplete AC checkboxes at close, and dead code comment references.
Production shell logic in reconcile-bridge, canary workflows, probe harness, and vote normalizer must be migrated to Python.
Code comments citing dead SHAs, run-ids, or dates must be remediated to ticket citations with CI regression prevention.
Oversized bug fixes must be blocked by Gerrit unless they have a current plan-review attestation.

Pre-330c epic children were silently skipped from completion attestation signing due to stale-material reads after checkbox normalization; grandfathering logic must recover certification for those children.
